name: Accessibility Audit (WCAG 2.2 AA)
description: Fast WCAG 2.2 AA triage of pages, components or PRs: keyboard, semantics, contrast and motion checks.
author: NickCrew

name: API Design
description: Conventions for REST resource naming, status codes, pagination, filtering, error formats, versioning and rate limits.
author: affaan-m (ECC)

name: Architect
description: Sketches types, signatures and module boundaries before coding, then implements against the sketch.
author: Cursor (cursor/plugins, pstack)

name: Benchmark Checklist
description: Checks a measured number for bottlenecks, errors, repeatability and whether the work actually ran before you report it.
author: Cursor (cursor/plugins, pstack)

name: Blast Radius
description: Finds what a small change could break elsewhere and proves the key safety fact by running code.
author: Cursor (cursor/plugins, pstack)

name: Brand Guidelines
description: Applies a fixed brand colour and typography set to any artefact that must match an identity.
author: Anthropic

name: Caveman
description: Terse communication: answer first, filler removed, technical facts and code kept exact.
author: Julius Brussee (JuliusBrussee)

name: Code Review (standards and spec)
description: Reviews a diff against the repo's standards and the originating spec in parallel, reporting both separately.
author: Matt Pocock (mattpocock)

name: Copywriting
description: Writes or rewrites page copy (headlines, value propositions, CTAs) starting from a diagnosis of the input.
author: Corey Haines (coreyhaines31)

name: Database Migrations
description: Safe, reversible schema and data changes: expand-contract renames, concurrent indexes, batched backfills.
author: affaan-m (ECC)

name: Deployment Patterns
description: CI/CD, Docker builds, health checks, rollback plans and a pre-release readiness checklist.
author: affaan-m (ECC)

name: Diagnosing Bugs
description: Structured loop for hard bugs and slow regressions: build a repro, rank hypotheses, end with a regression test.
author: Matt Pocock (mattpocock)

name: Domain Modeling
description: Sharpens domain terms, keeps a glossary current and records only the architecture decisions that are hard to reverse.
author: Matt Pocock (mattpocock)

name: E2E Testing (Playwright)
description: Stable Playwright suites: page objects, CI setup, artifacts and fixing flaky tests.
author: affaan-m (ECC)

name: Frontend Design
description: Subject-specific UI design that avoids templated, generic defaults.
author: Anthropic

name: Frontend Patterns (React and Next.js)
description: Component, state, data-fetching, performance, form and accessibility patterns for React and Next.js.
author: affaan-m (ECC)

name: Grill Me
description: Interviews you about a plan or design until every open branch is resolved.
author: Matt Pocock (mattpocock)

name: Handoff
description: Condenses the current conversation into a document another agent can resume from, with sensitive data redacted.
author: Matt Pocock (mattpocock)

name: I Have ADHD
description: Formats replies for an ADHD reader: next action first, numbered multi-step work, progress restated across turns.
author: Ayoub Ghriss (ayghri)

name: Internal Communications
description: Drafts updates, newsletters, FAQs, status and incident reports in company formats.
author: Anthropic

name: No Comments Pass
description: Strips comments before review, fixes the accepted findings and turns constraint comments into checks.
author: Cursor (cursor/plugins, pstack)

name: Pandas Pro
description: Pandas workflow for cleaning, aggregating, merging, reshaping, time series and performance tuning.
author: jeffallan

name: PostgreSQL Patterns
description: PostgreSQL query tuning, schema design, indexing and RLS, adapted from Supabase practices.
author: affaan-m (ECC)

name: Pull Request Body
description: Template for a PR body with a visual summary, before/after evidence and a merge-risk assessment.
author: Matt Pocock (mattpocock)

name: Security Review
description: Checklist and code patterns for auth, input validation, secrets, injection, XSS, CSRF, rate limiting and dependencies.
author: affaan-m (ECC)

name: Security Scan (AgentShield)
description: Audits a .claude directory for exposed secrets, broad permissions and risky hooks or MCP servers.
author: affaan-m (ECC)

name: Systematic Debugging
description: Finds the root cause in four phases before any fix is proposed.
author: Jesse Vincent (obra), with Prime Radiant

name: TDD (red-green-refactor)
description: Test-first development: one failing test, the smallest fix, then refactor.
author: Matt Pocock (mattpocock)

name: Technical Writing
description: Layered writing standard for docs, RFCs, readmes, PR descriptions and commit messages.
author: Cursor (cursor/plugins, pstack)

name: Issue and PR Triage
description: Runs issue and external PR triage with category and state labels, verifying claims before acting.
author: Matt Pocock (mattpocock)

name: TypeScript Best Practices
description: Makes illegal states unrepresentable, validates at data boundaries and avoids unsafe casts and any.
author: Cursor (cursor/plugins, pstack)

name: Unslop
description: Removes AI-writing patterns from text while keeping the meaning and tone.
author: Cursor (cursor/plugins, pstack)

name: Writing for Agents
description: Guidance for writing skills, AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md so agents behave predictably.
author: Matt Pocock (mattpocock)

name: Writing Plans
description: Turns a spec into a detailed step-by-step implementation plan with exact file paths and tests before code is written.
author: Jesse Vincent (obra), with Prime Radiant
